name: @penguinharness/use-bento-slides
description: Create and edit Bento presentations — self-contained .bento.html decks whose document is JSON. Use whenever the user wants a slide deck or presentation: from scratch, from source material, or by improving an existing file.

quick_start.prompt: Make a three-slide Bento deck in this Workspace introducing PenguinHarness: a title slide, what it does, and how to get started.
quick_start.prompt_zh: 在当前工作区做一份三页的 Bento 幻灯片介绍 PenguinHarness：标题页、它能做什么、如何上手。
